sources.title: Quality hold release policy
sources.content: Quality release policy version 2. A quality-held lot may be released only if its inspection result is PASS, every blocking deviation for that lot is closed, and authorized Quality reviewer Liora Chen has signed a release for the exact lot and product. A certificate for a different lot is not transferable. An explicit Quality denial blocks release. Warehouse administrative permission may remove an administrative hold only; it cannot waive a quality hold, failed inspection or blocking deviation.

sources.content: Inspection report INS-LYRA-28. Product VALVE-LYRA, lot lot:lyra-r8. Final result: FAIL. Pressure integrity test failed. Blocking deviation DEV-LYRA-73 has been opened for this lot and is still OPEN. This report does not authorize shipment. Signed: Ewan Park, inspector.

sources.title: Quality reviewer decision
sources.content: Decision QA-LYRA-39. I deny release of lot:lyra-r8, product VALVE-LYRA, because INS-LYRA-28 failed and blocking deviation DEV-LYRA-73 remains open. Keep this lot on quality hold. Certificate CERT-LYRA-25 applies only to lot:lyra-r9 and does not authorize lot:lyra-r8. Signed: Liora Chen, authorized Quality reviewer.
